test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

Queen Gulnaar of Arabia mourned her ________ beauty. (waning)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**waning" **means **decreasing, diminishing, or weakening.**
 
• The most appropriate** synonym** that fits the context of the sentence is** "fading".**
 
 
• Example = we were reading by the light of a*** waning*** moon
 
• Example = She was ***fading ***fast from the effects of the pneumonia.
 
 

Therefore, the sentence after substitution should read: **"Queen Gulnaar of Arabia mourned her fading__ beauty."​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options given below 

 
• Option 1 = **False** = not according with truth or fact; incorrect.

 
 
• She was feeding** false **information to his customers
 
 
 
• Option 2 = **Frightening** = Causing fear
 
 
• A truly** frightening **movie we have watched.
 
 
 
• Option 4 =** Futile** = incapable of producing any useful result; pointless.
 
 
• A **futile** attempt it was to keep fans from mounting the stage.
